_doc: Brand fact register (grounding layer). Single source for DSC facts used by qa_lint CL5 and scripts/fact_consistency.py. Edit a value here -> run `python scripts/fact_consistency.py --changed <id>` to list articles to update. status: verified | needs_confirmation. Check types: pct_allowed_range (every % in the sentence must be within [min,max] or in also_allowed), unit_value (number before `unit` must include one of `allowed`), code (every 6-digit number must equal `expected`). A sentence is checked only if it names DSC and contains all `trigger_all` and at least one `trigger_any`.
